result.reason: The added language states the preferred 30-day Customer convenience right, post-termination refund, and no Vendor mid-term convenience right, but it leaves Section 2.1’s directly conflicting take-or-pay commitment “without reduction or termination rights” unchanged. That conflict makes the operative termination right ambiguous and potentially ineffective. The right to terminate “in whole or in part” also goes beyond the playbook by permitting partial scope or volume reductions without terminating the relevant commitment. Section 2.1 should instead be narrowly conformed to make the commitment subject to the new termination right, and the new clause should be numbered and placed within the termination section.
